mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM OVERDUE o JOIN USER u ON o.uidx = u.uidx WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber} AND o.status = 'Y' ) THEN CONCAT('이용불가(~', (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(o2.endDate), '%Y.%m.%d') FROM OVERDUE o2 JOIN USER u2 ON o2.uidx = u2.uidx WHERE u2.userNumber = #{userNumber} AND o2.status = 'Y' ), ')') ELSE '이용가능' END AS loanStatus FROM USER u WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber};

SELECT b.coverImg, b.title, b.author, lb.code, DATE_FORMAT(l.loanDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS loanDate, DATE_FORMAT(l.dueDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS dueDate, CASE WHEN l.returnDate IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(l.returnDate, '%Y.%m.%d') ELSE '-' END AS returnDate, l.status FROM LOAN l JOIN USER u ON l.uidx = u.uidx JOIN LIBRARYBOOKS lb ON l.lbidx = lb.lbidx JOIN BOOKS b ON lb.bidx = b.bidx WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber} ORDER BY l.loanDate DESC LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LOAN l JOIN USER u ON l.uidx = u.uidx WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber}
mapper.update: UPDATE OVERDUE SET status = 'N' WHERE status = 'Y' AND endDate <= CURRENT_DATE()
